lines.text: How did you break your arms?
We recently had an agent go rogue: 009.
He tipped over the MI6 vending machine
Vending machine. What’s that code for?
It’s code for a vending machine. The one in the break room. We were out of change. 009 manipulated me into reaching inside for a snack.
He got impatient. Tipped over the machine and fled. I was left pined for fighting for my life. Kept alive by exactly 882 mike and ikes.

Counting those mike and ikes as they fell from the broken machine one by one into my mouth and watching Survivor reruns on the break room TV was the only thing that got me through those 12 excruciating hours.
Well GreeDay that is simply a remarkable story.
